lead: Yogi Adityanath is an Indian politician, born on 5 June 1972 in Panchur.
As of 2026, he is 54 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and Member of Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council.
This profile collects the Yogi facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Yogi Adityanath — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Yogi Adityanath was born on 5 June 1972 in Panchur, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University (A Central University).
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Yogi Adityanath — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and monk as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (2017–present), Member of Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council (2017–2022), Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly (2022–present), Member of the 12th Lok Sabha (1998–1999), Member of the 13th Lok Sabha (1999–2004) and Member of the 14th Lok Sabha (2004–2009). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2023.
